create_QwenConfig: create a QwenConfig dataclass instance with custom model_dim and num_layers for a Qwen model
register_qwen_configs: register all Qwen model architecture configs into a DependencyContainer using register_qwen_configs
build_qwen25_3b_config: build a Qwen 2.5 3B model config with 2048 model_dim and 36 layers via the qwen25_3b arch
build_qwen3_8b_config: build a Qwen 3 8B model config with 4096 model_dim and q_norm enabled via the qwen3_8b arch
review_QwenConfig_defaults: review the QwenConfig default values for model_dim, max_seq_len, vocab_size, and attention head settings
